sloka: तद् भवान् अस्य कार्यस्य साधनम् सत्य विक्रमः ।बुद्धि विक्रम संपन्नो हेतुः अत्र परंतपः ॥४-६५-२६॥
transliteration: tad bhavān asya kāryasya sādhanam satya vikramaḥ ।buddhi vikrama saṁpanno hetuḥ atra paraṁtapaḥ ॥4-65-26॥

translations.english: 'O warrior of proven valour O subduer of enemies in achieving this objective you are the source, being endowed with valour and wisdom.
